name: Programming Languages
description: A programming language lets you give instructions to a computer. Pick one and learn to use words, numbers, choices and repeated steps.

name: Web Development
description: Learn to build a web page. Start with HTML for page parts and CSS for colours and spaces. Then make your pages easy for everyone to use.

name: Frontend Frameworks & Libraries
description: These tools help you build the parts of an app that people see and click. Learn HTML, CSS and JavaScript before trying one of them.

name: Backend Development
description: A server is a computer that answers requests from other computers. These topics explain how to write programs that run on a server.

name: Databases
description: A database keeps data organised so you can find it again. Learn to store records, ask questions about them and change them.

name: DevOps, Cloud & Tools
description: Learn about tools that save code changes, check programs and put apps online. These topics come after your first coding lessons.

name: AI & Data Science
description: Data is a collection of facts or measurements. These topics explore patterns in data and how computers can learn from examples.

name: Software Engineering
description: Learn how to plan, organise and check your code. These skills help you build programs that are easier to understand and fix.
